title: drift with depth: the sheet edges sweep the frame while the pictures inside drift 12 % of the way (inside the crop margin, so no edge or mirror ever shows), nearer things a little more than the skyline (depth parallax 0.06 from the depth model's map); the front sheet half-transparent over the back one (all three seasons around the crossing); no blur
gag: Three seasons from one balcony in Ivano-Frankivsk (his order: 1 summer, 2 early autumn, 3 late autumn). Summer holds; the two other seasons slide in from opposite corners along a 62° diagonal, pass each other over summer, and leave; summer remains, so the clip loops. The output is the centre 75 % of the registered canvas (3600 px prep), so a drifting picture never runs out of pixels.
